definitions.explanation: A somewhat literary or emphatic word for the eye, more evocative than the everyday {目|め}. Appears in set expressions and descriptive writing.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{眼|まなこ}で{見|み}つめる。
{寝|ね}{不足|ぶそく}で{眼|まなこ}が{赤|あか}い。
examples.english: My eyes are red from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{血走|ちばし}った{眼|まなこ}で{相手|あいて}をにらみつけた。
examples.english: He glared at his opponent with bloodshot eyes.

notes:
A somewhat literary or emphatic word for 'eye,' more evocative than the everyday {目|め}. Appears in set expressions and descriptive writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝|ね}ぼけ{眼|まなこ}: sleepy, half-awake eyes
- どんぐり{眼|まなこ}: round, wide eyes
- {血走|ちばし}った{眼|まなこ}: bloodshot eyes (with intensity)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目|め}: eye — the ordinary, neutral everyday word
